en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hammad, from Al Halby, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘You should be saying in the two Sujūd for the omission, ‘In the Name of Allahazwj, and by Allahazwj. O Allahazwj! Send Blessings upon Muhammad and the Progenyasws of Muhammadsaww’.

Al-Halby said, ‘And I heard him another times saying, 
‘In the Name of Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, and by Allah<sup>azwj</sup>. Greetings be upon you O Prophet<sup>saww</sup>, and the Mercy of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> and His<sup>azwj</sup> Blessings’.
en.sarwar: 5. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Hammad from al-Hafabiy who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
In the two Sajdah (prostration) because of mistake say, ‘In the name of Allah and with Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause.’
Al-Halabiy has said that I heard him (the Imam) in another time say, ‘In the name of Allah and with Allah, O Holy prophet, Allah has granted you kindness and blessings.”’
